description.value:
You touch an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension, causing it to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that, in a color of your choosing, for the duration. Wrapping the object in something opaque blocks the light entirely, and you can end the power early as an action or by casting it again.

If you target an object being worn or carried by a hostile creature, that creature can avoid the effect with a successful Dexterity saving throw.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
